Game Overview

Hug and Kis Station Escape is a two-player game built around guide Hug and Kis, two alien pals, in their peaceful escape from a galactic outpost. Solve clever puzzles by collecting keys and gems. With no threats or time limits, enjoy a stress-free adventure where teamwork and exploration lead to success. Perfect for cooperative play and leisurely fun.
